supersededProposals.reason: Later G8.2, anti-pattern 2 and C6 permanently reject every production user-reachable example, demo or fixture-derived result surface. Synthetic fixtures remain test-only.
The binding consent-artifact contract uses /legal/consent/[key]/v/[version]; the conflicting proposed spelling never becomes a route.

Invitation mail uses the fixed /withdraw/request#token link; that page clears the fragment immediately and api.rights-activate exchanges the raw token once for a purpose-bound rights session before authenticated POST /api/invitations/accept. Raw credentials never enter a handler URL or the acceptance body.

Raw bearer values in a Vercel request path are exposed to platform proxy telemetry before application redaction. The registered patterns remain, but [token] accepts only non-secret request or session literals; issued links carry the raw token in the fragment and activation sends it in a closed POST body.
